## 2. Setting B: cross-camera association with GT boxes (mean ± std over seeds)

Leak-free split: appearance backbone trained on VeRi-776 (external dataset, no CityFlow vehicle); association network trained on S01+S03+S04 (vehicles unseen by the backbone); 2-fold cross-validation over S02/S05: early-stopping epoch, tau and theta for S02 are selected on S05 and vice versa. Identity clustering: average linkage (rows *_single: single linkage). FN = FP = 0 by construction, so IDP = IDR = IDF1 and MOTA = 1 - IDSW/GT.
